LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipForceHunt: Cause this animal to be hunted down to the specified limits, regardless of current nutrition levels and target.\n\nThis may cause other auto hunted animals to be hunted less depending on food needed, but if the nutrition level is set high enough this setting does nothing.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipLabel: The animal to be automatically hunted.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipCurrentTotal: The current number of wild animals, both male and female.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipMaxTotal: The maximum number of wild animals, both male and female.\n\nHunters will automatically hunt any extras.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipCurrentMales: The current number of wild males of breeding age.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipCurrentMalesYoung: The current number of wild baby and juvenile males.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipMaxMales: The maximum number of wild males of breeding age.\n\nHunters will automatically hunt any extras.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipMaxMalesYoung: The maximum number of wild baby and juvenile males.\n\nHunters will automatically hunt any extras.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipCurrentFemales: The current number of wild females of breeding age.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipCurrentFemalesYoung: The current number of wild baby and juvenile females.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipMaxFemales: The maximum number of wild females.\n\nHunters will automatically hunt any extras.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipMaxFemalesYoung: The maximum number of wild baby and juvenile females.\n\nHunters will automatically hunt any extras.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipCurrentPregnant: The current number of wild pregnant animals.
LanguageData.AutoHuntHeaderTooltipAllowHuntPregnant: Allow pregnant animals to be Hunted along with other females of the same species.
LanguageData.AutoHuntTooltipSetLimit: Click to set an animal count limit.
